tree.q: Is there a shared cache in front of the app?
tree.why: Without a shared cache there is no class here. Confirm with headers and age before spending time on keying.

branches.action: read the response headers and repeat one request. age, x-cache and cf-cache-status answer it
vary headers one at a time and watch the cached response. the first input that changes it and is not in the key is the opening
branches.oracle: a second clean session receives your value

branches.action: find a private route the cache will store under a static looking path, then request it without a session
no finding. say so and move on

mirror.control: key every varying input, never cache by default

mirror.control: cache only explicit routes, normalise before keying
mirror.rule: cache hit on an authenticated route
